meta.title: Piercing The Heavens
meta.description: Control the enemy's vitals and the situation will pivot once again.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: Why's it your turn to be the apprehensive one now, Eucharist?
units.displayText: Why's it your turn to be the apprehensive one now, Eucharist?

spans.text: Why's it your turn to be the apprehensive one now, Eucharist?

units.rawText: Ha... It's not over yet.
units.displayText: Ha... It's not over yet.

spans.text: Ha... It's not over yet.

units.rawText: Eucharist forces a composed appearance, but her expression betrays her innermost unease.
units.displayText: Eucharist forces a composed appearance, but her expression betrays her innermost unease.

spans.text: Eucharist forces a composed appearance, but her expression betrays her innermost unease.

units.rawText: Rook, check.
units.displayText: Rook, check.

spans.text: Rook, check.

units.rawText: One must not hurry to partake in a hot drink. Pointless checks do not serve any purpose.
units.displayText: One must not hurry to partake in a hot drink. Pointless checks do not serve any purpose.

spans.text: One must not hurry to partake in a hot drink. Pointless checks do not serve any purpose.

units.rawText: I pull my king backward, negating Eucharist's overbearing aggression.
units.displayText: I pull my king backward, negating Eucharist's overbearing aggression.

spans.text: I pull my king backward, negating Eucharist's overbearing aggression.

units.rawText: Queen, capturing white pawn.
units.displayText: Queen, capturing white pawn.

spans.text: Queen, capturing white pawn.

units.rawText: So you'd seek to attack me with Entropic fluid because you can't win the game? Unfortunately, I'm quite some ways from being Entropized.
units.displayText: So you'd seek to attack me with Entropic fluid because you can't win the game? Unfortunately, I'm quite some ways from being Entropized.

spans.text: So you'd seek to attack me with Entropic fluid because you can't win the game? Unfortunately, I'm quite some ways from being Entropized.

units.rawText: King, capturing black rook.
units.displayText: King, capturing black rook.

spans.text: King, capturing black rook.

units.rawText: Ack... hey, you're taking all of these pieces. Aren't you going to send any messages?
units.displayText: Ack... hey, you're taking all of these pieces. Aren't you going to send any messages?

spans.text: Ack... hey, you're taking all of these pieces. Aren't you going to send any messages?

units.rawText: The time hasn't come yet. Don't we both want to end this game? Let's get on with it, then.
units.displayText: The time hasn't come yet. Don't we both want to end this game? Let's get on with it, then.

spans.text: The time hasn't come yet. Don't we both want to end this game? Let's get on with it, then.

units.rawText: Your turn.
units.displayText: Your turn.

spans.text: Your turn.

units.rawText: Gah... queen, here...
units.displayText: Gah... queen, here...

spans.text: Gah... queen, here...

units.rawText: What a shame. Seems to me that the game is decided.
units.displayText: What a shame. Seems to me that the game is decided.

spans.text: What a shame. Seems to me that the game is decided.

units.rawText: How about a draw? Shall we play another game?
units.displayText: How about a draw? Shall we play another game?

spans.text: How about a draw? Shall we play another game?

units.rawText: I am still in my element here, remember.
units.displayText: I am still in my element here, remember.

spans.text: I am still in my element here, remember.

units.rawText: I would love to, but it seems that some other guests are intent on interrupting our pastime.
units.displayText: I would love to, but it seems that some other guests are intent on interrupting our pastime.

spans.text: I would love to, but it seems that some other guests are intent on interrupting our pastime.

units.rawText: I shrug, pointing at the Entropized Endurance at the door.
units.displayText: I shrug, pointing at the Entropized Endurance at the door.

spans.text: I shrug, pointing at the Entropized Endurance at the door.

units.rawText: What is it? Can't you see that we're playing...
units.displayText: What is it? Can't you see that we're playing...

spans.text: What is it? Can't you see that we're playing...

units.rawText: ...What?!
units.displayText: ...What?!

spans.text: ...What?!

units.rawText: Looks like taking that many pieces previously has finally paid dividends?
units.displayText: Looks like taking that many pieces previously has finally paid dividends?

spans.text: Looks like taking that many pieces previously has finally paid dividends?

units.rawText: Watching as Eucharist's confident attitude crumbles, I give the terminal in my hands a good shake.
units.displayText: Watching as Eucharist's confident attitude crumbles, I give the terminal in my hands a good shake.

spans.text: Watching as Eucharist's confident attitude crumbles, I give the terminal in my hands a good shake.

units.rawText: You wanted me to send messages, didn't you? I think I'll just have you listen in.
units.displayText: You wanted me to send messages, didn't you? I think I'll just have you listen in.

spans.text: You wanted me to send messages, didn't you? I think I'll just have you listen in.

units.rawText: Beeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeep—

spans.text: Beeeep—

units.rawText: I'm the Oasis' Professor, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I'm the Oasis' Professor, {교수}.

spans.text: I'm the Oasis' Professor,

units.rawText: You can finally make calls? It must've been a ton of work!
units.displayText: You can finally make calls? It must've been a ton of work!

spans.text: You can finally make calls? It must've been a ton of work!

units.rawText: ...Croque?!
units.displayText: ...Croque?!

spans.text: ...Croque?!

units.rawText: Seeing the figure in the call, Eucharist goes wide-eyed but soon finds her composure.
units.displayText: Seeing the figure in the call, Eucharist goes wide-eyed but soon finds her composure.

spans.text: Seeing the figure in the call, Eucharist goes wide-eyed but soon finds her composure.

units.rawText: Hmph, what's the point in putting on false bravado like this? What can she do? Under our surveillance...
units.displayText: Hmph, what's the point in putting on false bravado like this? What can she do? Under our surveillance...

spans.text: Hmph, what's the point in putting on false bravado like this? What can she do? Under our surveillance...

units.rawText: Wait, could that message just then about the railgun be...
units.displayText: Wait, could that message just then about the railgun be...

spans.text: Wait, could that message just then about the railgun be...

units.rawText: First, you must ensure the safety of Croque and her squad near the railgun.
units.displayText: First, you must ensure the safety of Croque and her squad near the railgun.

spans.text: First, you must ensure the safety of Croque and her squad near the railgun.

units.rawText: Well, well, I was worried she would go and cause trouble. If you intend to avoid conflict, Professor, I'm more than happy to oblige.
units.displayText: Well, well, I was worried she would go and cause trouble. If you intend to avoid conflict, Professor, I'm more than happy to oblige.

spans.text: Well, well, I was worried she would go and cause trouble. If you intend to avoid conflict, Professor, I'm more than happy to oblige.

units.rawText: You were too confident then and thought yourself in full control of the railgun. Unfortunately, just as there is no undo on the chessboard, there's no cure for regrets.
units.displayText: You were too confident then and thought yourself in full control of the railgun. Unfortunately, just as there is no undo on the chessboard, there's no cure for regrets.

spans.text: You were too confident then and thought yourself in full control of the railgun. Unfortunately, just as there is no undo on the chessboard, there's no cure for regrets.

units.rawText: Do you seriously think that I never realized you might go and fiddle with the railgun? You must take me for an imbecile, Professor.
units.displayText: Do you seriously think that I never realized you might go and fiddle with the railgun? You must take me for an imbecile, Professor.

spans.text: Do you seriously think that I never realized you might go and fiddle with the railgun? You must take me for an imbecile, Professor.

units.rawText: The railgun's control rights are facilitated via wire, and they are still under my control.
units.displayText: The railgun's control rights are facilitated via wire, and they are still under my control.

spans.text: The railgun's control rights are facilitated via wire, and they are still under my control.

units.rawText: Eucharist brandishes the terminal in her hand, but her dismay is written all over her face.
units.displayText: Eucharist brandishes the terminal in her hand, but her dismay is written all over her face.

spans.text: Eucharist brandishes the terminal in her hand, but her dismay is written all over her face.

units.rawText: If you so insist, we can provide a bit of commentary. Croque, clarify the situation, if you would.
units.displayText: If you so insist, we can provide a bit of commentary. Croque, clarify the situation, if you would.

spans.text: If you so insist, we can provide a bit of commentary. Croque, clarify the situation, if you would.

units.rawText: Alright! I'll skip the recounting of previous events. Basically, me and Hannah pinned down and loosened all the control ports for the railgun.
units.displayText: Alright! I'll skip the recounting of previous events. Basically, me and Hannah pinned down and loosened all the control ports for the railgun.

spans.text: Alright! I'll skip the recounting of previous events. Basically, me and Hannah pinned down and loosened all the control ports for the railgun.

units.rawText: So what? The moment the connection begins to sever, I'll burn your beloved Oasis to ash. I don't make empty threats!
units.displayText: So what? The moment the connection begins to sever, I'll burn your beloved Oasis to ash. I don't make empty threats!

spans.text: So what? The moment the connection begins to sever, I'll burn your beloved Oasis to ash. I don't make empty threats!

units.rawText: If you think you've got what it takes, then go cut all the connections at once—
units.displayText: If you think you've got what it takes, then go cut all the connections at once—

spans.text: If you think you've got what it takes, then go cut all the connections at once—
Do it!

units.rawText: Dirac, full power!
units.displayText: Dirac, full power!

spans.text: Dirac, full power!

units.rawText: As Croque gave the command, the other end of the call broke into bedlam, alarms shrieking.
units.displayText: As Croque gave the command, the other end of the call broke into bedlam, alarms shrieking.

spans.text: As Croque gave the command, the other end of the call broke into bedlam, alarms shrieking.

units.rawText: Dirac leverages both of its arms, clamping down on the massive weapon's base and pivoting the entirety of the railgun with raw force alone.
units.displayText: Dirac leverages both of its arms, clamping down on the massive weapon's base and pivoting the entirety of the railgun with raw force alone.

spans.text: Dirac leverages both of its arms, clamping down on the massive weapon's base and pivoting the entirety of the railgun with raw force alone.

units.rawText: The wires and cables responsible for controlling the weapon, including the cords connected to the energy supply, were completely unrooted, ripped apart by the railgun's abnormal locomotion.
units.displayText: The wires and cables responsible for controlling the weapon, including the cords connected to the energy supply, were completely unrooted, ripped apart by the railgun's abnormal locomotion.

spans.text: The wires and cables responsible for controlling the weapon, including the cords connected to the energy supply, were completely unrooted, ripped apart by the railgun's abnormal locomotion.

units.rawText: Dirac—handcannon mode, <size=40>COM—PLETE!</size>
units.displayText: Dirac—handcannon mode, COM—PLETE!

spans.text: Dirac—handcannon mode,
COM—PLETE!

units.rawText: <size=40>WHAT?!</size>
units.displayText: WHAT?!

spans.text: WHAT?!

units.rawText: <size=40>Impossible! Fire, you piece of...!</size>
units.displayText: Impossible! Fire, you piece of...!

spans.text: Impossible! Fire, you piece of...!

units.rawText: No matter how Eucharist fiddles with the controls, she finds no feedback through the terminal.
units.displayText: No matter how Eucharist fiddles with the controls, she finds no feedback through the terminal.

spans.text: No matter how Eucharist fiddles with the controls, she finds no feedback through the terminal.

units.rawText: With that, the railgun is back in our hands.
units.displayText: With that, the railgun is back in our hands.

spans.text: With that, the railgun is back in our hands.

units.rawText: ...Even so, all that's accomplished is to place us both back at the starting point.
units.displayText: ...Even so, all that's accomplished is to place us both back at the starting point.

spans.text: ...Even so, all that's accomplished is to place us both back at the starting point.

units.rawText: Dislodging the ranged control modules is equivalent to cutting off the operand supply with no possibility of repair. Destroying the railgun like this doesn't do you any good.
units.displayText: Dislodging the ranged control modules is equivalent to cutting off the operand supply with no possibility of repair. Destroying the railgun like this doesn't do you any good.

spans.text: Dislodging the ranged control modules is equivalent to cutting off the operand supply with no possibility of repair. Destroying the railgun like this doesn't do you any good.

units.rawText: Hahaha, still in denial, I see.
units.displayText: Hahaha, still in denial, I see.

spans.text: Hahaha, still in denial, I see.

units.rawText: "Destroy" is maybe the wrong word; it's just turned into a one-time-use thing. The operand load inside the turret is sufficient for one more shot. After that, it'll be well and truly good for scrap.
units.displayText: "Destroy" is maybe the wrong word; it's just turned into a one-time-use thing. The operand load inside the turret is sufficient for one more shot. After that, it'll be well and truly good for scrap.

spans.text: "Destroy" is maybe the wrong word; it's just turned into a one-time-use thing. The operand load inside the turret is sufficient for one more shot. After that, it'll be well and truly good for scrap.

units.rawText: And... it is precisely that which makes for a most captivating romance! Ura!
units.displayText: And... it is precisely that which makes for a most captivating romance! Ura!

spans.text: And... it is precisely that which makes for a most captivating romance! Ura!

units.rawText: Thank you, Croque.
units.displayText: Thank you, Croque.

spans.text: Thank you, Croque.

units.rawText: It's also thanks to the commands the Professor's been sending over from time to time. With Hannah and Turing's efforts, Rossum's defense systems are back up and running.
units.displayText: It's also thanks to the commands the Professor's been sending over from time to time. With Hannah and Turing's efforts, Rossum's defense systems are back up and running.

spans.text: It's also thanks to the commands the Professor's been sending over from time to time. With Hannah and Turing's efforts, Rossum's defense systems are back up and running.

units.rawText: I'll just sit here and keep watch over the railgun. The Entropics won't get around me!
units.displayText: I'll just sit here and keep watch over the railgun. The Entropics won't get around me!

spans.text: I'll just sit here and keep watch over the railgun. The Entropics won't get around me!

units.rawText: Wait for my command on when and where to fire the railgun.
units.displayText: Wait for my command on when and where to fire the railgun.

spans.text: Wait for my command on when and where to fire the railgun.

units.rawText: <size=40>Understood!</size>
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: The call ends. In the space of a mere few minutes, the situation had undergone a complete reversal.
units.displayText: The call ends. In the space of a mere few minutes, the situation had undergone a complete reversal.

spans.text: The call ends. In the space of a mere few minutes, the situation had undergone a complete reversal.

units.rawText: I raise the white king and slam it down, setting this game's result in stone.
units.displayText: I raise the white king and slam it down, setting this game's result in stone.

spans.text: I raise the white king and slam it down, setting this game's result in stone.

units.rawText: You have no pieces remaining to mount an effective attack with. Now, it's truly "checkmate".
units.displayText: You have no pieces remaining to mount an effective attack with. Now, it's truly "checkmate".

spans.text: You have no pieces remaining to mount an effective attack with. Now, it's truly "checkmate".

units.rawText: Tch... ahahahahaha!
units.displayText: Tch... ahahahahaha!

spans.text: Tch... ahahahahaha!

units.rawText: Eucharist bursts into a guffaw, overturning the chessboard and sending the pieces upon it skidding across the floor.
units.displayText: Eucharist bursts into a guffaw, overturning the chessboard and sending the pieces upon it skidding across the floor.

spans.text: Eucharist bursts into a guffaw, overturning the chessboard and sending the pieces upon it skidding across the floor.

units.rawText: You can't possibly think that this game will truly affect anything, right? Even without the railgun, I've got plenty of other ways to keep you here!
units.displayText: You can't possibly think that this game will truly affect anything, right? Even without the railgun, I've got plenty of other ways to keep you here!

spans.text: You can't possibly think that this game will truly affect anything, right? Even without the railgun, I've got plenty of other ways to keep you here!

units.rawText: Giving up on the pretenses now, are we? These rules were set by none other than you yourself.
units.displayText: Giving up on the pretenses now, are we? These rules were set by none other than you yourself.

spans.text: Giving up on the pretenses now, are we? These rules were set by none other than you yourself.

units.rawText: The rules of games are written by the victors. Ptolemaea!
units.displayText: The rules of games are written by the victors. Ptolemaea!

spans.text: The rules of games are written by the victors. Ptolemaea!

units.rawText: All Sanctifiers take aim at hostile entity [Eucharist]. Prepare to fire!
units.displayText: All Sanctifiers take aim at hostile entity [Eucharist]. Prepare to fire!

spans.text: All Sanctifiers take aim at hostile entity [Eucharist]. Prepare to fire!

units.rawText: As the jellyfish Entropics spring into action, countless red dots hone in on Eucharist from outside the building.
units.displayText: As the jellyfish Entropics spring into action, countless red dots hone in on Eucharist from outside the building.

spans.text: As the jellyfish Entropics spring into action, countless red dots hone in on Eucharist from outside the building.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: We've known each other for some time. Of course, I'd have precautions for this possibility, don't you think?
units.displayText: We've known each other for some time. Of course, I'd have precautions for this possibility, don't you think?

spans.text: We've known each other for some time. Of course, I'd have precautions for this possibility, don't you think?

units.rawText: Thankfully, this game went on for so long that even if the Reverse Babylon Tower's reinforcements could not make it here, the Lesser Sanctifiers from the nearby watchtowers were more than enough to surround this place.
units.displayText: Thankfully, this game went on for so long that even if the Reverse Babylon Tower's reinforcements could not make it here, the Lesser Sanctifiers from the nearby watchtowers were more than enough to surround this place.

spans.text: Thankfully, this game went on for so long that even if the Reverse Babylon Tower's reinforcements could not make it here, the Lesser Sanctifiers from the nearby watchtowers were more than enough to surround this place.

units.rawText: Tch... trifling Lessers...
units.displayText: Tch... trifling Lessers...

spans.text: Tch... trifling Lessers...

units.rawText: Another matter that I noticed earlier. The Entropic liquid's spread has slowed significantly, and the amount of jellyfish Entropics has stopped increasing.
units.displayText: Another matter that I noticed earlier. The Entropic liquid's spread has slowed significantly, and the amount of jellyfish Entropics has stopped increasing.

spans.text: Another matter that I noticed earlier. The Entropic liquid's spread has slowed significantly, and the amount of jellyfish Entropics has stopped increasing.

units.rawText: I shake off the Entropic liquid clinging to my legs, leaning forward.
units.displayText: I shake off the Entropic liquid clinging to my legs, leaning forward.

spans.text: I shake off the Entropic liquid clinging to my legs, leaning forward.

units.rawText: It seems like the "black queen"'s operand supply is at its end. Faith, how does the combat analysis look?
units.displayText: It seems like the "black queen"'s operand supply is at its end. Faith, how does the combat analysis look?

spans.text: It seems like the "black queen"'s operand supply is at its end. Faith, how does the combat analysis look?

units.rawText: I swear it upon the esteem of the Sanctifier name—we will do whatever it takes to exterminate these Daemons.
units.displayText: I swear it upon the esteem of the Sanctifier name—we will do whatever it takes to exterminate these Daemons.

spans.text: I swear it upon the esteem of the Sanctifier name—we will do whatever it takes to exterminate these Daemons.

units.rawText: Sounds like it'll be a grueling struggle on both sides if they are to pull the trigger. Are you sure about this, Eucharist?
units.displayText: Sounds like it'll be a grueling struggle on both sides if they are to pull the trigger. Are you sure about this, Eucharist?

spans.text: Sounds like it'll be a grueling struggle on both sides if they are to pull the trigger. Are you sure about this, Eucharist?

units.rawText: Sullenly, Eucharist waves her hand, placating the jellyfish horde.
units.displayText: Sullenly, Eucharist waves her hand, placating the jellyfish horde.

spans.text: Sullenly, Eucharist waves her hand, placating the jellyfish horde.

units.rawText: It just so happens that I'd like to give the Oasis with some good news for once. You'd do well to take this time to think things over.
units.displayText: It just so happens that I'd like to give the Oasis with some good news for once. You'd do well to take this time to think things over.

spans.text: It just so happens that I'd like to give the Oasis with some good news for once. You'd do well to take this time to think things over.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.

spans.text: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.

units.rawText: ...That's about it for the plan. Antonina, anything you'd like to add?
units.displayText: ...That's about it for the plan. Antonina, anything you'd like to add?

spans.text: ...That's about it for the plan. Antonina, anything you'd like to add?

units.rawText: Everything was explained pretty clearly. I'll update everyone on the exact arrangements in a second.
units.displayText: Everything was explained pretty clearly. I'll update everyone on the exact arrangements in a second.

spans.text: Everything was explained pretty clearly. I'll update everyone on the exact arrangements in a second.

units.rawText: If there are no questions, let us prepare for the final battle. According to the combat analysis in regards to the Entropics, we should begin in 30 minutes.
units.displayText: If there are no questions, let us prepare for the final battle. According to the combat analysis in regards to the Entropics, we should begin in 30 minutes.

spans.text: If there are no questions, let us prepare for the final battle. According to the combat analysis in regards to the Entropics, we should begin in 30 minutes.

units.rawText: <size=40>Understood!</size>
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: With a lively call and response, the room soon empties, and everyone hurries to attend to their preparations.
units.displayText: With a lively call and response, the room soon empties, and everyone hurries to attend to their preparations.

spans.text: With a lively call and response, the room soon empties, and everyone hurries to attend to their preparations.

units.rawText: I should go confirm the planned route again...
units.displayText: I should go confirm the planned route again...

spans.text: I should go confirm the planned route again...

units.rawText: Beeeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeeep—

units.rawText: Her terminal rings out of the blue again. Driven by some unspeakable premonition, she immediately picks up the call.
units.displayText: Her terminal rings out of the blue again. Driven by some unspeakable premonition, she immediately picks up the call.

spans.text: Her terminal rings out of the blue again. Driven by some unspeakable premonition, she immediately picks up the call.

units.rawText: Persicaria? I'm <cmdr>, are you alright?
units.displayText: Persicaria? I'm {교수}, are you alright?

spans.text: Persicaria? I'm
, are you alright?

units.rawText: P-Professor!
units.displayText: P-Professor!

spans.text: P-Professor!

units.rawText: Persicaria struggles against the shuddering in her voice as a familiar voice visits her senses again after so long.
units.displayText: Persicaria struggles against the shuddering in her voice as a familiar voice visits her senses again after so long.

spans.text: Persicaria struggles against the shuddering in her voice as a familiar voice visits her senses again after so long.

units.rawText: I'm alright. How have things fared for you? Were you wounded while facing off against Eucharist?
units.displayText: I'm alright. How have things fared for you? Were you wounded while facing off against Eucharist?

spans.text: I'm alright. How have things fared for you? Were you wounded while facing off against Eucharist?

units.rawText: I'm very safe where I am. Most importantly, Croque's regained control of Rossum's railgun, and Eucharist has no more tools to threaten us with.
units.displayText: I'm very safe where I am. Most importantly, Croque's regained control of Rossum's railgun, and Eucharist has no more tools to threaten us with.

spans.text: I'm very safe where I am. Most importantly, Croque's regained control of Rossum's railgun, and Eucharist has no more tools to threaten us with.

units.rawText: If we need to, she can use it to help in the Oasis' defense. Just note that it'll need time to charge up and a set of coordinates, and that it's only got one shot left.
units.displayText: If we need to, she can use it to help in the Oasis' defense. Just note that it'll need time to charge up and a set of coordinates, and that it's only got one shot left.

spans.text: If we need to, she can use it to help in the Oasis' defense. Just note that it'll need time to charge up and a set of coordinates, and that it's only got one shot left.

units.rawText: Fantastic! The Oasis is currently under attack by a High Order Entropic named "Ptolemaea". I'll send the relevant reports about the situation, as well as her location, to you...
units.displayText: Fantastic! The Oasis is currently under attack by a High Order Entropic named "Ptolemaea". I'll send the relevant reports about the situation, as well as her location, to you...

spans.text: Fantastic! The Oasis is currently under attack by a High Order Entropic named "Ptolemaea". I'll send the relevant reports about the situation, as well as her location, to you...

units.rawText: Do you need me to come back to the Oasis or command remotely?
units.displayText: Do you need me to come back to the Oasis or command remotely?

spans.text: Do you need me to come back to the Oasis or command remotely?

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at the operation countdown on the screen in front of her, tightly gripping her terminal.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at the operation countdown on the screen in front of her, tightly gripping her terminal.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at the operation countdown on the screen in front of her, tightly gripping her terminal.

units.rawText: ...Will be fine.
units.displayText: ...Will be fine.

spans.text: ...Will be fine.

units.rawText: Opening her eyes again, Persicaria's resolve and courage shine through in those orbs.
units.displayText: Opening her eyes again, Persicaria's resolve and courage shine through in those orbs.

spans.text: Opening her eyes again, Persicaria's resolve and courage shine through in those orbs.

units.rawText: We plan to begin an operation targeting Ptolemaea in 25 minutes. The exact details I've sent to you.
units.displayText: We plan to begin an operation targeting Ptolemaea in 25 minutes. The exact details I've sent to you.

spans.text: We plan to begin an operation targeting Ptolemaea in 25 minutes. The exact details I've sent to you.

units.rawText: And... I'd like to rely on you, but you are facing your own hardships, right? Leave it to us here.
units.displayText: And... I'd like to rely on you, but you are facing your own hardships, right? Leave it to us here.

spans.text: And... I'd like to rely on you, but you are facing your own hardships, right? Leave it to us here.

units.rawText: Persicaria, you've grown.
units.displayText: Persicaria, you've grown.

spans.text: Persicaria, you've grown.

units.rawText: Yeah, I've been much encouraged by everyone here.
units.displayText: Yeah, I've been much encouraged by everyone here.

spans.text: Yeah, I've been much encouraged by everyone here.

units.rawText: I'm more or less done with reviewing the plan. Very exact and something only you lot could come up with.

units.rawText: You mean...

units.rawText: Alright!
units.displayText: Alright!

spans.text: Alright!

units.rawText: Receiving my affirmation, Persicaria beams.
units.displayText: Receiving my affirmation, Persicaria beams.

spans.text: Receiving my affirmation, Persicaria beams.

units.rawText: Thank you, truly, for your trust. I would be lying if I said I had no qualms, but it is a relief to hear your voice before we commence the operation.
units.displayText: Thank you, truly, for your trust. I would be lying if I said I had no qualms, but it is a relief to hear your voice before we commence the operation.

spans.text: Thank you, truly, for your trust. I would be lying if I said I had no qualms, but it is a relief to hear your voice before we commence the operation.

units.rawText: I believe that... our operation will be successful. In that, I have no doubt.
units.displayText: I believe that... our operation will be successful. In that, I have no doubt.

spans.text: I believe that... our operation will be successful. In that, I have no doubt.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: I end the call, turning my attention to Eucharist on the other side of the board. Her legs shuddered, no doubt from anxiety.
units.displayText: I end the call, turning my attention to Eucharist on the other side of the board. Her legs shuddered, no doubt from anxiety.

units.displayText: Given it some good thought, I assume?

spans.text: Given it some good thought, I assume?

units.rawText: You really are a boor, Professor, urging me like this.
units.displayText: You really are a boor, Professor, urging me like this.

spans.text: You really are a boor, Professor, urging me like this.

units.rawText: I happen to be in a good mood, so I'll not bicker with you.

units.displayText: Beeeeep—

units.rawText: Croque, what is it?
units.displayText: Croque, what is it?

spans.text: Croque, what is it?

units.rawText: The railgun's primed on Ptolemaea, ready to go at any time.

units.rawText: Aeugh...
units.displayText: Aeugh...

spans.text: Aeugh...

units.rawText: Right, you wanted another game, right? We have a lot of time on our hands, it seems.
units.displayText: Right, you wanted another game, right? We have a lot of time on our hands, it seems.

spans.text: Right, you wanted another game, right? We have a lot of time on our hands, it seems.

units.displayText: I don't think I've ever mentioned it, but there is another game I prefer to chess.

spans.text: I don't think I've ever mentioned it, but there is another game I prefer to chess.

units.displayText: I make a sliding motion on my terminal, and the projected chessboard takes on another form.

spans.text: I make a sliding motion on my terminal, and the projected chessboard takes on another form.

units.rawText: Let's have a change of pace and have a game of Go, shall we?
units.displayText: Let's have a change of pace and have a game of Go, shall we?

spans.text: I've just remembered something that's coming up. Do you think we could maybe call it...

units.rawText: Oh, don't be such a downer. Besides, how am I to know how those Sanctifiers outside will respond?
